blocks.text: EA Pro Painters is a professional painting company in Bellevue, WA on the Eastside of the greater Seattle area. Our main areas we service are the Eastside cities of Bellevue, Redmond, Issaquah, Woodinville, Sammamish, Duvall, Bothell, Factoria and Kirkland.

blocks.text: We’ve helped keep the Eastside of colorful and beautiful for many years, serving both residential and commercial customers with consistent delivery of the highest-quality services at competitive prices. We always work with honesty, integrity, and a smile!

blocks.text: Our team of experienced professionals is dedicated to delivering exceptional quality, value, and service to our customers. We use only the best paint and materials. Our goal is to provide a painting solution that is affordable, reliable, and hassle-free.
